activities.activity_description: Analyze all user stories, design overall architecture, define module interactions, and plan implementation details for the software increment.
Develop the HDFS sink module to write data to Hadoop Distributed File System, including coding, configuration, and initial unit tests.
Integrate Hadoop commands into the shell interface, enabling users to query HDFS directly, with error handling and user feedback.
Research and design repository options for storing composed job definitions, evaluating persistence mechanisms and data models.
Implement orchestration functionality to manage workflows of composed jobs, including state tracking, error recovery, and monitoring support.
Develop unit and integration tests for shell commands to ensure isolation, covering edge cases and error conditions.
Add support for binding message properties to microservice modules via expressions or similar mechanisms, enhancing data flow flexibility.
Migrate the JDBC module from XD to SCDF repository, refactoring code and adapting it as a sink for streaming pipelines.
Migrate the Kafka module from XD to SCDF repository, updating configurations and ensuring compatibility as a source for streaming pipelines.
Integrate all implemented modules, perform end-to-end testing, resolve conflicts, and finalize the software increment for release.
